font-size.comment: Body/root font-size = the rem base for the document. Framework-level token (kept under the conduction key so every theme emits the same --conduction-root-font-size variable). Use a RELATIVE unit (rem or %) only, never px, so it honours the user's own browser font-size / zoom (accessibility). Consuming apps apply font-size: var(--conduction-root-font-size, 1rem) on html/body. 1rem = the user's base, 16px by default.
